title: Working with agents on Databricks
sub: The seventh film of Agents at work on data, a series on putting AI agents to work on data: at the Faculty of Health, three people's own agents, each with its own copy of the data, give three answers to one question; on Databricks, every agent reads the same governed data through the same tools: agents that answer, tool servers any agent can use, agents the team builds and tests, and agents that write code, while people review and approve.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. The agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person. Blue is a tool or the platform, violet the model, orange the data and its evidence, green what is checked and agrees, amber a slip or a doubt. The platform's pages are drawn for the film; where the voice names Databricks, dbt or MCP, its official logo stands beside the name.
